requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-001 - The room shall be represented as a single well-mixed air volume of 100 m3.
requirements.text: The room shall be represented as a single well-mixed air volume of 100 m3.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-002 - Outdoor air shall be supplied through a controlled airflow path and room air shall leave through an exhaust path.
requirements.text: Outdoor air shall be supplied through a controlled airflow path and room air shall leave through an exhaust path.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-003 - The ventilation controller shall modulate fresh-air flow using measured room CO2 as feedback.
requirements.text: The ventilation controller shall modulate fresh-air flow using measured room CO2 as feedback.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-004 - During the approved occupied schedule, room CO2 shall not exceed 1000 ppm.
requirements.text: During the approved occupied schedule, room CO2 shall not exceed 1000 ppm.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-005 - The reference outdoor-air CO2 concentration shall be 300 ppm.
requirements.text: The reference outdoor-air CO2 concentration shall be 300 ppm.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-006 - CO2 generation shall be proportional to the scheduled number of occupants.
requirements.text: CO2 generation shall be proportional to the scheduled number of occupants.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-007 - The design occupant CO2 generation rate shall be 8.18E-6 kg/s per person.
requirements.text: The design occupant CO2 generation rate shall be 8.18E-6 kg/s per person.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-008 - The released demonstration shall support a peak occupancy of at least 12 persons.
requirements.text: The released demonstration shall support a peak occupancy of at least 12 persons.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-009 - A numerical simulation shall demonstrate the CO2 feedback behavior over a representative daily occupancy schedule.
requirements.text: A numerical simulation shall demonstrate the CO2 feedback behavior over a representative daily occupancy schedule.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-010 - Concentration and airflow quantities shall be represented with explicit engineering units or unambiguous normalization definitions.
requirements.text: Concentration and airflow quantities shall be represented with explicit engineering units or unambiguous normalization definitions.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-011 - The model shall distinguish physical outdoor-air flow direction from any implementation-specific source sign convention.
requirements.text: The model shall distinguish physical outdoor-air flow direction from any implementation-specific source sign convention.

requirements.quote: URS-IAQ-012 - Verification evidence shall record occupant count, room CO2, outdoor CO2, commanded ventilation, and physical ventilation flow.
requirements.text: Verification evidence shall record occupant count, room CO2, outdoor CO2, commanded ventilation, and physical ventilation flow.
